title: White Horse Cellar Old Blend, Circa 1960's
seen_in_photos: Yellow paper label with white horse, stage coach vignette, pink back label, gold foil capsule with pull tab, fill in neck at about the shoulder-to-neck level, no ABV or proof visible.
text_read: THIS LABEL IS REGISTERED; By Appointment to Her Majesty the Queen; Scotch Whisky Distillers; Aged in Wood; EU No 5489523; The Old Blend Scotch Whisky of the White Horse Cellar from the Original Recipe 1746; Estab. 1742; White Horse Distillers Ltd., Lagavulin Distillery, Island of Islay, and Glenlivet District, Glasgow and London; Distilled and bottled in Scotland; MARCA REGISTRADA (vertical); Distilled in Scotland and bottled in the United Kingdom under government supervision; Printed in Scotland. Back: We guarantee White Horse to be very old pure Scotch Whisky ... certified by Wallace and Clark's monthly analysis ... White Horse Distillers Ltd, Island of Islay, Glasgow and London.
not_in_title: Spanish language 'Marca Registrada' marking suggests an export label for a Spanish-speaking market; label names Lagavulin and Glenlivet as component distilleries; no ABV or proof and government supervision strip suggest older than the late 1960s possible; Queen's warrant (Elizabeth II, so after 1952).
unreadable: Fill volume and proof not stated; capsule text partly hidden.
bottling_era: Circa 1950s to 1960s: no barcode, no ABV or proof, 'by appointment to Her Majesty the Queen', foil capsule, paper label.
condition: Back label torn at lower edge and small hole; label scuffed and toned; capsule creased with a small gap at top; fill looks in the neck (high shoulder is not reached). Warning: label tears.
reason: Real but modest: older-style export label, plausible 1950s to early 1960s, with Lagavulin named on label. Title circa 1960's is broadly right. Collectors of old White Horse pay a premium but this is a standard blend.

title: White Horse Logan's Extra Age Superb King's Special Old Scotch Whisky, Circa 1950's (GB)
seen_in_photos: Octagonal dark glass flask-style bottle with gold and grey front label, screw cap gold foil capsule, paper strip label on back, cream back label, stone-effect moulded presentation box behind.
text_read: LOGAN'S Extra Age SUPERB OLD Scotch Whisky KING'S SPECIAL; By Appointment to Her Majesty the Queen; Scotch Whisky Distillers; White Horse Distillers Ltd Glasgow & London; 1742; Distilled and bottled in Scotland; Distilled in Scotland and bottled in the United Kingdom under government supervision, Printed in Scotland; Laird O'Logan King's Special is a blend of whiskies from the oldest and most famous stills in Scotland and is guaranteed to be a pure and natural whisky of great age entirely free from any artificial sweetening, flavouring or other foreign matter; White Horse Distillers Ltd Glasgow Islay & London.
not_in_title: Screw cap (not cork) with a pilfer-proof foil; Queen's warrant (post 1952); decanter-like faceted bottle; stone-effect box. No ABV or proof, no volume visible. Box is not identified in title beyond GB.
unreadable: Fill level and any proof or volume marking not visible through dark glass.
bottling_era: Circa 1950s to 1960s: screw cap, no ABV, Queen's warrant.
condition: Dark glass hides fill level; back strip label has torn edge; box has some wear and chips. Fill level not assessable.
reason: Title is accurate and already flags GB. Distinctive Logan's King's Special in faceted bottle and rock box is collectible, but nothing material is hidden. Screw cap suggests late 1950s to 1960s.
